update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.1 - July 2026 Game Update Compatibility
Added ----- - OCR Stat Cap Override: Training Settings → Behavior → "OCR Stat Cap Override" slider (0–2000, step 50, default 0 = auto). Set this if the bot ever rejects a legitimate stat read above 1200 after the July 2026 extended-cap update. At 0 the bot uses the new auto ceiling of 1800. - Stat target sliders now go up to 1600 (was 1200) so you can target the higher values now reachable with the July 2026 soft-cap change. - "All Max" distance preset now applies 1600 instead of 1200, matching the new extended range. - Scoring sandbox stat input fields raised to max 1600.
Fixed ----- - OCR no longer rejects legitimate stat values above 1200. The internal validation ceiling is raised from 1200 to 1800 to match the July 2026 update where stats past 1200 are still reachable (with halved gains). Previously, any OCR read above 1200 was silently discarded as a misread, causing stale or missing stat data in extended-cap scenarios. - URA Duel handler now covers all five stat choices (Speed, Stamina, Power, Guts, Wits). Previously only Speed, Power, and Wits were selectable, so the bot could miss the optimal pick if Stamina or Guts was the trainee's highest stat. Also expanded the carousel search from 3 to 6 passes to accommodate the new 6-option layout (5 stats + energy) introduced by the July 2026 Happy Meek duel update.
